corrections.caveats: No numbers in the repo; the claim rests on the SPIRE 2024 paper 'Another Virtue of Wavelet Forests' (arXiv 2308.07809), which was not opened. The README describes a benchmark harness (gen_text, build_wt, build_wf, bench_access, CSV output, a block-size sweep) that does not exist in the repo. The actual timing code, src/main.cpp, has hard-coded placeholder file paths and a fixed 10 MB block; its wavelet-tree loop discards the result of wt[i] (the compiler may remove it), while the forest loop prints every character to stdout inside the timed region, so the two timings are not comparable. The README calls the license permissive, but the LICENSE file is GPL-3.0 and the source headers say 'Copyright (c) Boucher Lab. All rights reserved. Licensed under the GNU license'. Research-grade code, 1 star.
